name: Bersenbrück (Germany)
description: White field with narrow red stripes along the top and bottom edges, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bersenbrück (a red bridge and a gate building on white).
history: Municipal flag of Bersenbrück; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bersenbrück arms — bridge and gate building on white
